{{Quote|My scouts have identified a Flesh Raider command base in the mountains. It's protected by an energy shield. The shield's power generator is hidden on a different mountain, in a well-guarded cave network.''"<br />"''That command base is probably coordinating all the attacks in the region. I need to get inside there.|Ranna Tao'ven and Orgus Din|<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] came into [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] learned the location of a [[Flesh Raider command base]] in the nearby [[Tythos Ridge]] from the village's [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] gathered several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and Masters to '''attack''' the base while he sent his newest [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] to [[Raid on the Tythos Ridge shield generator|deactivate]] the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting it.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" />

The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was successful in the mission, allowing the strike team to attack and destroy the command base, but the apprentice was also forced to [[Skirmish in the Kalikori village fields|defend Kalikori]] from enemy saboteurs while the main assault was underway.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> During their attack, the Order discovered the locations of many smaller camps across the planet, and the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] was forced to send all available Jedi to eliminate them in a series of simultaneous strikes.<ref name="Dark Temptations" />

==Behind the scenes==
The assault appears in<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', occurring concurrently with the events of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] mission "The Face of the Enemy."<ref name="The Face of the Enemy" /> The assault's success leads directly into the following mission, where the player is tasked with the [[Raid on the Forsaken Den|destruction]] of a camp in the [[Forsaken Den]].<ref name="Dark Temptations" />
